correctness.rationale: Pass applies to the corrected RESULT.md in /workspace/repairs/3/. The frozen text defined the conductor using every strictly greater integer, which instead picks the last gap when gaps exist; e.g. <3,5,7> has last gap 4 but conductor 5. The repaired definition explicitly requires all integers at least c to belong to the semigroup and gives c=0 at the smooth boundary m=2. It also expresses map degree via the pullback of O(1), distinct from the birational degree. Over algebraically closed characteristic zero, the distinct nonzero roots of T_n pair by ±u, giving squarefree h_m with h_m(−1)≠0. In Z²=(X+1)h_m(X)²/2 the double roots give distinct tangents and exactly m ordinary nodes. The inverse Z/h_m(X) and the basepoint-free degree-n system on P¹ give the normalization, degree and only point at infinity. Independently, the cone has coordinates W=A², X=AB, Y=2B²−A², Z=T from weights (1,1,2); the closure is cut in this weighted coordinate ring by the primitive irreducible polynomial A^(n−4)T²−(A+B)(A^m h_m(B/A))²/2 of weight n. Its even Veronese Hilbert function for d≥m is (d+1)²−(d−m)(d−m+1), verifying p_a=m(m−1) and the cone computation. The normalization has one point over infinity; coordinate orders there are n,n−2,n−4. For a=n−4, the residue minima for <a,a+2,a+4> are a ceil(j/2)+2j for 0≤j<a, obtained by using the fewest increments of size 1 or 2 to reach j. The gap count is m(m−2), which equals the local delta from genus minus the m finite node contributions. The inclusion of this semigroup in the actual value semigroup is then equality, by the length/gap identity for a unibranch completed local ring. The largest Apéry value minus a plus one yields the stated conductor in the corrected convention, and the a=1 case is smooth.

value.rationale: The low frequencies (2,4) force a natural quadric cone relation in the Chebyshev family. The uniform computation shows exactly how an explicit rational family attains extremal arithmetic genus: the affine nodes and one very different infinity branch account for every unit of genus defect. The precise local value semigroup, rather than just a numerical lower bound or an abstract semigroup calculation, is usable for normalization and local singularity comparisons. This value survives the conductor-definition repair and does not depend on claiming the classical Castelnuovo calculation as new.
residual_risks: No extension to other frequency triples, phase shifts, or embedded resolution data is claimed.
